title: Neural Tracking to go
description: A mobile EEG dataset of auditory attention from 20 participants performing a two-competing-speaker paradigm. Participants either sat on a chair or walked an indoor route while attending to one of two speakers. Salient environmental events presented from in front of the participant were used to disrupt attention, allowing neural tracking of speech to be studied in realistic, mobile conditions.
methods_description: Mobile EEG was recorded during a two-competing-speaker auditory attention task, in which participants were either seated or walking an indoor route. Salient environmental events were presented from in front of the participant to disrupt attention.
